days: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Aerobic Power

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Warm-up: bike + movement prep
exercises.focus: Bike 5 min easy; then dynamic prep, ankle rocks, front-rack and thoracic mobility, 2-3 empty-bar drills.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Spanish squat isometric
exercises.logHint: Pain 0-10 during + next-AM stiffness
exercises.focus: Tendon prep. Tolerable knee angle; upright trunk; equal pressure through both feet.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Hang power clean (EMOM every 90s)
exercises.logHint: Top load; bar-path & catch quality; any knee response
exercises.focus: Skill/power. EMOM format so it flows rhythmically; low reps protect bar speed. Stop the set if bar path loops or the catch destabilises.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Heel-elevated front squat - top set
exercises.logHint: Top load; RPE-1; depth owned Y/N; knee pain during + next AM
exercises.focus: Main lower-body strength. Heel-elevated. Only use a depth you can own with a vertical torso; no rebound out of the bottom.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 1 (Mon) - Clean Skill + Front Squat + Knee Capacity
exercises.name: Backward sled drag
exercises.logHint: Total load; knee response during + next AM
exercises.focus: Knee-capacity work plus low-impact conditioning. Short controlled steps; stay tall; no sprinting. One turf lane only.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Warm-up: row + banded shoulder prep
exercises.focus: Row 5 min easy; banded shoulder prep; empty-bar dip-and-drive drills.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Bench press - top set
exercises.logHint: Top load; RPE-1
exercises.focus: Strength maintenance. Pause the first rep; leg drive without excessive lumbar extension.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.

exercises.day: Day 2 (Tue) - Jerk Skill + Upper Strength + Aerobic Power
exercises.name: Air bike intervals
exercises.logHint: Avg watts/cal if shown; HR recovery between
exercises.focus: Aerobic-power conditioning; low impact. Hard but controlled, not all-out. One bike = considerate footprint.
exercises.progression: Week 1 baseline; establish technique and a tolerable load.
